notes: 0029: add Repeat login by phone for a selected saved account. Prefill its phone number and request the code using the delivery method returned by Telegram, including Telegram Desktop service messages; support the 2FA password when required. Probe valid sessions without requesting a code. Reauthenticate expired sessions with a fresh temporary key, verify the selected owner and saved account identity, then install under the unchanged session name so rules and usage settings remain intact. Local snapshots protect cancellation, incorrect codes, wrong owners and failed saves; temporary sessions are cleaned even after rollback errors. QR login and the existing new-account phone flow remain available.
